quotations.old_english: Nis be him gerǽd ðæt hé handling ǽnigne man ácwealde
quotations.english: it is not read of him that he killed any man with his own hands

source_text: handlinga; adv. With the hands :-- Nis be him gerǽd ðæt hé handling ǽnigne man ácwealde it is not read of him that he killed any man with his own hands, Homl. Th. i. 386, 1.
